The '''Nelona Lightsaber''' was a type of [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilt]] used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Nelona Lightsaber first appeared in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], and was available for all players to acquire from May 4th to 6th 2012, via a promotional code found after winning the "Aquatic Assault" minigame on the game's website.
